items.source: Query that specifies the documents to run on child documents of the type field.
items.translation: 指定在 `<code>type` 字段的子文档上运行的查询。

items.source: Obtaining nested objects and documents that have a parent-child relationship.
items.translation: 获取具有父子关系的嵌套对象和文档。

items.source: Indicates how scores for matching child documents affect the root parent document’s relevance score.
items.translation: 指示匹配的子文档的评分如何影响根父文档的相关性评分。

items.source: Indicates whether to ignore an unmapped type and not return any documents instead of an error. Default, this is set to false.
items.translation: 指示是否忽略未映射的type并返回空文档而不是错误。默认情况下，此值设置为false。

items.source: Indicates whether to ignore an unmapped type and not return any documents instead of an error.
items.translation: 指示是否忽略未映射的type，不返回任何文档而不是抛出错误。

items.source: The Maximum number of child documents that match the query allowed for a returned parent document.
items.translation: 返回的父文档允许匹配的 `query` 子文档的最大数量。

items.source: Minimum number of child documents that match the query required to match the query for a returned parent document.
items.translation: 返回的父文档必须匹配查询中至少指定数量的子文档。

items.source: The Maximum number of child documents that match the query allowed for a returned parent document. If the parent document exceeds this limit, it is excluded from the search results.
items.translation: 返回的父文档允许匹配的 `query` 子文档的最大数量。如果父文档超过此限制，则将其排除在搜索结果之外。

items.source: Minimum number of child documents that match the query required to match the query for a returned parent document. If the parent document does not meet this limit, it is excluded from the search results.
items.translation: 返回的父文档必须匹配的查询子文档的最小数量。如果父文档未达到此限制，则将其从搜索结果中排除。
